_source: The upgrades NAC already sell, at the prices Nick gave: "make it so airtouch is 1350 and each temp sensor is 100 each all to be chosen", then "oh make it $110 then". Nothing here was priced by the program, and nothing here is a manufacturer figure the program worked out for itself.
_brandLock: The AirTouch kit NAC stock is the Daikin one. Both lines require `daikin_system`, so on a quote where the customer can also choose a Braemar they are not shown greyed out — they are not shown at all, and they cannot end up in a Braemar total.
_howToUse: Open /quote-presentation.html, sign in, Optional upgrades, then 'Import NAC upgrades'. Check the prices against what you are charging today, then Save library.

upgrades.title: AirTouch 5 smart control
upgrades.description: Upgrade from the standard Daikin wall controller to AirTouch 5: colour touchscreen, phone app control from anywhere, and each zone set to its own temperature instead of simply open or shut.

upgrades.title: Room temperature sensors
upgrades.description: A temperature sensor in the rooms you choose, so AirTouch holds that room to its setpoint rather than reading the air at the return. One per room — pick how many.

_pictures: Nick, 5 November 2026: "Airtouch pictures next to Airtouch option, sensor next to sensor option", then "Just need Airtouch sensor pic replaced" with the manufacturer's sensor image. The pairing is stated here rather than left to the title matcher: matching is a convenience for an upgrade nobody has paired, and a pairing Nick asked for by name should not depend on which words happen to be in a description. Clear the field in /quote-presentation.html to go back to matching.
